known_limitations.description: Signature-alert promotion is not e2e-verified; detection depends on upstream Suricata rules. Techniques reflect coarse finding-category mappings, not per-signature ATT&CK coverage. Exfiltration tactic TA0010 is omitted.
Unit/state test sources (not golden-PCAP evidence): services/ids-alerts/test_bu3_identity.py, services/ids-alerts/test_promote.py
Measured quality is computed by services/feedback-service/quality.py (KTD2); static confidence weights are not measured precision or false-positive rates.
